checks.text: The page shows the heading "Tip Calculator" and the tab buttons "Bill" and "Split".
Typing 100 in the field labelled "Bill amount" and 8 in the field labelled "Tax amount" shows the summary lines "Subtotal: $100.00", "Tax: $8.00", and "Total: $108.00".
Moving the slider labelled "Tip percentage" to 15 shows the line "Tip: $15.00" and "Total: $123.00".
Typing 4 in the field labelled "Number of people" shows the line "Per person: $30.75".
Clicking the tab "Split" (with 4 people) shows the table with the header row "Person", "Paid", "Owes", and the row "1", "$0.00", "$30.75".

In the Split tab with bill 100, tax 8, tip 15% and "Number of people" set to 2 (share $61.50), typing 50 in the field labelled "Person 1 paid" and 73 in the field labelled "Person 2 paid" shows the transfer line "Person 1 pays Person 2 $11.50".
Clicking the button "Copy summary" copies the text "Total: $123.00, Per person: $30.75" to the clipboard.
Selecting "10%" in the select labelled "Tip preset" sets the slider labelled "Tip percentage" to 10 and shows "Tip: $10.00".
Reload keeps the bill amount 100, tax 8, tip 15%, and 4 people, showing "Total: $123.00" and "Per person: $30.75".
